dct_description_sm: U.S. Navy Hydrographic Office Emergency Reproduction of Japanese Chart.
Relief shown by contours and spot heights.
Shows city plan, farmland, low water areas, roads, waterways.
Names, facilities, etc., in Japanese only.
Map 1. Aioi Wan and Approaches [Inset: Aioi Kô] -- Map 2. Takasago Kô -- Map 3. Sikama Kô
